hook.name: uTokenHook
hook.description: ETH/token v4 hook: before/afterSwap burn a fixed % of the token each swap (immutable rate, 10% cap) via IBurnable.burn. Pool init and all liquidity actions are gated to an immutable `authorized` address; the token side of liquidity is held by the hook. authorized can also move any ERC-20 out of the hook to any address via withdrawToken (source: full supply minted to the hook at launch). ~30 init/seed functions are identical aliases under different names (stake, deposit, claim, multicall, etc.).
